def Lift (x : ℕ → ℚ) : Formula → Prop
  | .eq a b => ev x a = ev x b
  | .atom f => ev x f = 0
  | .call τ g _ => τ.Rel fun k => ev x (g k)
  | .and fs => ∀ φ, (_ : φ ∈ fs) → Lift x φ
  | .or fs => ∃ φ, ∃ (_ : φ ∈ fs), Lift x φ
decreasing_by all_goals (have := List.sizeOf_lt_of_mem ‹_ ∈ fs›; simp; omega)
